description: This source file defines a partial class for the Catalog Items Listing page in a Blazor web application. It manages the lifecycle, interactions, and data binding for catalog items, types, and brands, including injecting services and handling user actions such as view details, create, edit, and delete operations.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Partial class for the Catalog Item listing page, encapsulating state management, service injections, and user interaction handlers.

methods.name: OnAfterRenderAsync
methods.description: Handles component rendering lifecycle; loads catalog data on first render.

methods.description: Handles user action to view details of a specific catalog item.

methods.name: CreateClick
methods.description: Handles user action to initiate creation of a new catalog item.

methods.name: EditClick
methods.description: Handles user action to edit an existing catalog item.

methods.name: DeleteClick
methods.description: Handles user action to delete a catalog item.
